description.narrative: UNRWA has made significant investments in the safety and security of its staff, assets and facilities and security procedures despite financial challenges. In 2023, the Agency will continue to focus on security personnel staffing costs, the procurement of communication devices such as VHF radios, as training on security. These investments will enable UNRWA to facilitate and provide security support for over 600 field missions in 2023 in a medium to high risk security environment, and to conduct security risk assessments of its installations.
